data.exact_reserve_text: Within this profit, there was a profit arising from the reinsurance to close received from 2015 year of account of GBP 9.4m before expenses and investment return (see Note 8 on page 26). This arose largely from a reduction in the 2015 and prior years' liability reserves as a result of favourable settlements in 2018.

The total cost incurred to the Syndicate from these storms is currently $14.1m, with $4.9m, net of reinsurance, affecting the 2016 Account.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 11.629 million for the 2015 and prior years of account. This favourable development was primarily driven by a reduction in liability reserves due to favourable settlements in 2018. The 2016 account was impacted by claims from the 2017 hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria (HIM), with a net cost of $4.9 million affecting it. The 2017 year of account also bore the brunt of the HIM catastrophes, with net incurred losses of $6.5 million for the year, though these remained within early reserve estimates. For the current year (2018), the syndicate experienced several natural catastrophe events including Hurricanes Florence and Michael, devastating wildfires in California, and an active typhoon season in Asia. However, due to a diminished reinsurance catastrophe account, these events were not expected to have a meaningful impact on loss ratios.
